description: Perform comprehensive structure analysis and deep data analysis on complex genomics archive file

input_data.notes: Complex genomics data - structure and content are unknown and must be discovered

part_1_structure_discovery.description: Deep structural analysis of the archive to understand organization and content
requirements: Extract and catalog the complete directory structure of the archive
Identify ALL file types present (by extension and actual content inspection)
Document the hierarchical organization and naming conventions
Determine the size, count, and distribution of each file type
Identify relationships between files (e.g., paired files, reference files, metadata files)
Detect any README, documentation, or metadata files and extract their content
Create a comprehensive structure map showing how data is organized
Infer the likely purpose and meaning of each directory and file type
Identify the primary data files vs auxiliary/metadata files
Document any compression, encoding, or special formats used
quality_requirements: Analysis must be EXHAUSTIVE - examine every file in the archive
Do NOT make assumptions - inspect actual file contents to verify types
Document EVERYTHING discovered, no matter how small
Create machine-readable outputs (JSON) for downstream use
part_1_structure_discovery.output: Comprehensive structure analysis with catalog, hierarchy map, and detailed documentation

part_2_data_analysis.description: Deep analysis of the actual data content within the archive
requirements: For each major file type identified, perform appropriate deep analysis
Extract and analyze metadata from all files that contain it
For tabular data: analyze schema, data types, distributions, missing values, relationships
For text data: analyze format, structure, content patterns, vocabulary
For binary data: analyze format, headers, structure, data patterns
For sequence data: analyze format, sequence characteristics, quality metrics if available
Identify data quality issues: missing values, anomalies, inconsistencies, errors
Compute comprehensive statistics for all analyzable data
Identify relationships and linkages between different files/datasets
Extract sample data from each file type for illustration
Document the biological/scientific meaning if determinable from the data
Identify any standard genomics formats (FASTA, FASTQ, VCF, BAM, BED, etc.)
quality_requirements: Analysis must be THOROUGH and DETAILED - not superficial
Use domain-appropriate methods for each data type
Generate visualizations where meaningful (distributions, relationships, patterns)
Document findings with specific examples and evidence
Highlight important discoveries, anomalies, or notable patterns
Create both technical analysis and accessible summaries
part_2_data_analysis.output: Comprehensive data analysis report with statistics, visualizations, and insights

requirements: Create an executive summary of the entire archive
Document the complete data inventory with descriptions
Provide a data dictionary for all identified data elements
Create a visual structure diagram or tree representation
Summarize key findings and insights from the analysis
Identify potential use cases or analysis opportunities
Document data quality assessment and any issues found
Provide recommendations for working with this data
Create a comprehensive HTML report that integrates all findings
Generate machine-readable metadata files (JSON) for programmatic access
quality_requirements: Report must be PROFESSIONAL and PUBLICATION-QUALITY
Include both high-level summaries and detailed technical information
Make it accessible to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ensure all findings are well-documented and reproducible
part_3_synthesis_and_documentation.output: Professional comprehensive report with executive summary, detailed findings, and metadata

part_1_outputs: structure_catalog.json - Complete file catalog with metadata
directory_tree.txt - Visual tree representation of archive structure
file_type_analysis.json - Detailed analysis of each file type
part_2_outputs: data_statistics/ - Folder with statistics for each data type
data_visualizations/ - Folder with all generated visualizations
sample_data/ - Folder with representative samples from each file type
part_3_outputs: metadata.json - Machine-readable metadata about the entire archive
recommendations.md - Recommendations for working with this data

notes: This is unknown complex data - take time to understand it properly
Do NOT rush - thoroughness and accuracy are paramount
Use appropriate domain-specific tools and methods when identified
Document the analysis process and reasoning, not just results
If specialized genomics formats are detected, use appropriate parsers/tools

critical_instructions.for_structure_analysis: WORKFLOW: Step 1: Extract archive safely to temporary location. Step 2: Recursively scan and catalog ALL files. Step 3: Inspect file contents (not just extensions) to verify types. Step 4: Build hierarchical structure map. Step 5: Analyze patterns and relationships. Step 6: Generate comprehensive documentation. Do NOT skip any files or directories.
critical_instructions.for_data_analysis: WORKFLOW: Step 1: For each major file type, determine appropriate analysis method. Step 2: Extract samples for inspection. Step 3: Perform type-specific analysis (statistical for tabular, content analysis for text, format analysis for binary). Step 4: Generate visualizations incrementally. Step 5: Document findings with evidence. Step 6: Synthesize insights. Quality is more important than speed - be thorough.
critical_instructions.for_documentation: WORKFLOW: Step 1: Gather all analysis results. Step 2: Create executive summary highlighting key findings. Step 3: Build comprehensive HTML report with navigation, sections, visualizations. Step 4: Generate machine-readable metadata. Step 5: Write recommendations based on findings. The final report should be professional enough to share with stakeholders.

quality_standards.completeness: Every file must be examined, every data type analyzed
quality_standards.accuracy: Verify findings, do not make unfounded assumptions
quality_standards.clarity: Reports must be clear, well-organized, and accessible
quality_standards.reproducibility: Document methods and provide code/scripts where applicable
